detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for rapid changes or suspicious commits in open source dependencies, especially those made by maintainers with recently changed credentials. Implement automated security analysis throughout the development lifecycle to detect injected malicious code and vulnerabilities as early as possible. Track and respond to breach notifications and unusual activity in open source components and web applications.
